name: Boil Release
summary: Boil Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, a combination of fire and water. Whereas most kekkei genkai are largely identical between users, Boil Release has different forms depending on who's using it.

name: Byakugan
summary: The Byakugan is a kekkei genkai dōjutsu that originated from the Ōtsutsuki clan, making it the oldest kekkei genkai. After the Ōtsutsuki settled on Earth, the Byakugan became more commonly associated with the Hyūga clan, direct descendants of the Ōtsutsuki. It is regarded as one of the "Three Great Dōjutsu", the others being the Sharingan and the Rinnegan.

debut.ova: Finally a clash! Jōnin vs. Genin!! Indiscriminate Grand Melee Tournament Meeting!!

name: Crystal Release
summary: Crystal Release is a rare nature that is seen only in the anime.

name: Dark Release
summary: Dark Release is a combined nature transformation kekkei genkai that can be used to absorb, manipulate, and release chakra taken from an opponent. Hiruko used techniques of this nature through a mark on his left hand. This mark resembles two diamonds, one overlapping the other. Chakra is absorbed through the upper square, while it is released and manipulated through the lower.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

name: Explosion Release
summary: Explosion Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, suggested to be a combination of earth and lightning. Explosion Release users utilise explosive chakra in combat.

debut.movie: Road to Ninja: Naruto the Movie
debut.game: Naruto Shippūden: Gekitō Ninja Taisen! EX

name: Iburi Clan's Kekkei Genkai
summary: This unique kekkei genkai is possessed by the members of the Iburi clan, which allows them to turn their bodies, either partially or fully, into smoke to serve various purposes. While in their smoke form the user becomes impervious to damage and can use this trait to gain an opportunity in battle, for example by allowing weapons to slip through them without any effects. However, if needed, they can still interact with physical objects.

name: Ice Release
summary: Ice Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, a combination of water and wind. The Land of Water's Yuki clan was feared for the power of their Ice Release, forcing its members to go into hiding to escape persecution.

debut.movie: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow

name: Jōgan
summary: The Jōgan is a unique dōjutsu that is known only by the Ōtsutsuki Clan, whose members claim that it is troublesome and a power strongly inherited from their clan. In the manga, the dōjutsu is featureless in appearance with a barely visible pupil. When depicted in the anime, the dōjutsu is light blue in colour with a darkened sclera and visible pupil.

debut.novel: The New Leaves Soaring Through the Blue Sky!

name: Jūgo's Clan's Kekkei Genkai
summary: The kekkei genkai of Jūgo's clan is an instinctual ability which allows its members to absorb and make use of natural energy without any training in senjutsu.

name: Ketsuryūgan
summary: The Ketsuryūgan, is a dōjutsu, which appears in certain individuals of the Chinoike clan. The Ketsuryūgan is recognised by its reddish colour, giving a special appearance for the users of this dōjutsu, characterised as holders of "eyes as red as blood". Its power earned it comparison to the Three Great Dōjutsu.

name: Kurama Clan's Kekkei Genkai
summary: A rare trait of the Kurama Clan. Every few generations, a member will be born with an incredible talent for genjutsu. The clan member's prowess in that field is so absolute that even without proper training, their genjutsu is simply overwhelming. Furthermore, the genjutsu is so powerful that it causes the brain to believe anything that happens to the victim to the point where the genjutsu physically harms the victim's body in the same manner they envisioned. This fearsome ability allows the clan member to potentially kill their opponents with genjutsu.

name: Lava Release
summary: Lava Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, a combination of fire and earth. Whereas most kekkei genkai are largely identical between users, Lava Release has a variety of forms depending on who's using it.

name: Magnet Release
summary: Magnet Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, suggested to be a combination of wind and earth. Magnet Release users generate a magnetic force which they apply to other substances for various purposes.

debut.game: Naruto Shippūden: Gekitō Ninja Taisen! EX 2

name: Mangekyō Sharingan
summary: The Mangekyō Sharingan is an advanced form of the Sharingan that has only been activated by a handful of Uchiha when enduring a traumatic enough experience. They are noted to be the "heavenly eyes that see the truth of all of creation without obstruction".

debut.novel: Naruto Jinraiden: The Day the Wolf Howled
debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

name: Mud Release
summary: Mud Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, a combination of water and earth, the same natures used to create Wood Release. Few people have ever heard of Mud Release, to the point that Hidan was surprised it exists.

debut.novel: Akatsuki Hiden: Evil Flowers in Full Bloom

name: Ranmaru's Kekkei Genkai
summary: Ranmaru uniquely possessed a dōjutsu kekkei genkai which, when activated, causes his eyes to glow red in colour. It grants him abilities similar to those of the Byakugan, which his own dōjutsu has been likened to.

name: Rinha Clan's Kekkei Genkai
summary: The kekkei genkai of the Rinha clan allows them to absorb a person's chakra and duplicate their appearance and memories.

name: Rinnegan
summary: The Rinnegan is reputed as the most exalted eye amongst the "Three Great Dōjutsu", the others being the Sharingan and the Byakugan, and the strongest dōjutsu. It is said that in times of disorder, one who wields the Rinnegan is sent down from the heavens to become either a "God of Creation" who will calm the world or a "God of Destruction" who will reduce everything to nothingness. The Rinnegan is characterised by concentric circles covering the eyeball.

name: Ryūzetsu's Kekkei Genkai
summary: This unnamed kekkei genkai apparently allows the user to perform Reincarnation Ninjutsu as it allowed Ryūzetsu to perform the Dragon Life Reincarnation technique. It was seen only in Naruto the Movie: Blood Prison and Ryūzetsu was the only known user. Other details, such as whether it was common or rare and whether any other technique could be performed using it, are unknown.

name: Sakon and Ukon's Kekkei Genkai
summary: Sakon and Ukon's unnamed kekkei genkai gives them the unique ability to break their bodies down to a molecular level. The two brothers usually use this ability to share the same body by fusing their cells but can also use it to merge with the bodies of others and destroy the host's cells from the inside. When Sakon is in need of assistance, Ukon can bring out some of his body parts to aid Sakon in blocking or attacking. Ukon's arms and legs can emerge from those of Sakon's to increase the force and quantity to his physical attacks.

name: Scorch Release
summary: Scorch Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai. When Sasuke Uchiha and Naruto Uzumaki combine their fire and wind-natured techniques, the resulting technique is dubbed "Scorch Release", suggesting those are its component natures.

name: Senrigan
summary: The Senrigan is a dōjutsu awakened by some members of the Ōtsutsuki Clan, which grants vast clairvoyant abilities. Appearance-wise, it is distinguished by a bright-blue iris, a white-glowing pupil surrounded by a dark, waxing crescent shape, and a darkened sclera.

name: Sharingan
summary: The Sharingan is the dōjutsu kekkei genkai of the Uchiha clan that appears selectively among its members. It is regarded as one of the "Three Great Dōjutsu", the others being the Byakugan and the Rinnegan.

debut.movie: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow

name: Shikotsumyaku
summary: Shikotsumyaku is a kekkei genkai which gives its wielder the ability to manipulate their own bones. It very rarely manifests within members of the Kaguya clan, of which Kimimaro was the last survivor.

name: Steel Release
summary: The Steel Release is a combined nature transformation kekkei genkai. It is unknown what elements this nature entails.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

name: Storm Release
summary: Storm Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, a combination of lightning and water. It is used by several shinobi from Kumogakure, most notably Darui.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

name: Swift Release
summary: Swift Release is a combined nature transformation kekkei genkai that can be used to move with incredible speed, becoming nothing more than a blur when in motion. Therefore, taijutsu becomes ineffective if the opponent is not fast enough.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

name: Tenseigan
summary: The Tenseigan is a dōjutsu introduced in The Last: Naruto the Movie. The movie's novelisation explains that the Tenseigan can be acquired when an Ōtsutsuki is implanted with the Byakugan of a Hyūga: this combination of the two clans' chakra transforms the Byakugan into Tenseigan.

name: Typhoon Release
summary: Typhoon Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, which consists of at least the wind nature transformation. It seems to essentially be a stronger form of Wind Release, involving the creation of vortexes that decimate the user's surroundings. Its only known user is Nowaki.

name: Wood Release
summary: Wood Release is a nature transformation kekkei genkai, a combination of Earth and Water Release. It was famously used by Hashirama Senju, and in fact is not known to have naturally occurred in anyone else, with the exception of the Ten-Tails, whose true form is the God Tree, leading to it being regarded as impossible to use without having his cells. Because of Wood Release's power and versatility, there have been various efforts to reproduce it after Hashirama's death.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Lost Tower

name: Kokugan
summary: The Kokugan (黒眼, literally meaning: Black Eye) is a dōjutsu used by Isshiki Ōtsutsuki and later Kawaki through his Kāma. It features a black pupil which glows gold when jutsu are used, and a black wheel-like pattern with eight spokes coming out of the centre. The iris area between adjacent spokes is gold.

name: Yanaru's Kekkei Genkai
summary: Yanaru possesses a unique Kekkei Genkai, allowing him to mentally exchange information with his shadow clones, just as clones are able to transmit information to the main body. Yanara employs it to coordinate his clones for assassinations, while disguising himself as a member of his target's inner circle, where he acquires the necessary information to carry out the assassination, relaying it to his clones.

debut.novel: Naruto Retsuden: Naruto Uzumaki and the Spiral Destiny

name: Rinne Sharingan
summary: The Rinne Sharingan is a dōjutsu kekkei mōra and the predecessor to the Rinnegan and Sharingan. It is characterised by red sclerae and irides, with a ripple pattern spreading over the eyeball and nine tomoe.

name: Dust Release
summary: Dust Release is a nature transformation kekkei tōta, a combination of earth, wind, and fire. To perform Dust Release, users form a small three-dimensional object (e.g. a cube, a cone, etc.) out of chakra in their hands. The object expands once released by the user and moves astonishingly fast at its target; anything that passes through it (or that is passed through by it) is disintegrated on a molecular level.
